result.reason: The redline minimally fixes the software warranty duration by providing 12 months from delivery and retains repair, replacement, and conditional refund remedies. However, it does not add a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, compliance with laws, or an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty; the existing protection applies only to willfully introduced code. It also uses delivery of the Software as the trigger for the hosted service warranty, which may be inapplicable or ambiguous. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language omissions.
